dataType.description: The Type that should be invoked to retrieve data for the {@link PdfComponent}.

actionName.description: The name of the action defined on {@link PdfComponentDataSpec#dataType}.

actionArgs.description:
The arguments supplied to {@link PdfComponentDataSpec#actionName}. No arguments supplied
if not specified.

start.description: The start time of the data to be plotted.

end.description: The end time of the data to be plotted.

interval.description: The interval to plot all of the metric data in the chart at.

noTimeZoneConversion.description:
Whether or not the time zone should be converted to local browser time (i.e. if the event happened
at 1 AM EST then it will be displayed at 1 AM in the PDF if noTimeZoneConversion is false).

plotSpecs.description: The timeseries plots to be visualized in the chart.

eventSpecs.description: The time-based events to be plotted in the chart.

title: The data specification for the {@link PdfTimeseriesChart}. Specifies the data to be plotted in the chart.
name: PdfTimeseriesChartDataSpec
